headlines.text: It was 2021 when Rocky Romero made their first appearance under the AEW banner against Bryan Danielson, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.60 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Romero's Dynamite in-ring debut, and a first meeting with Danielson since 2008 ? Orange Cassidy scouted from ringside for his own upcoming Full Gear match, adding real intrigue to a hard-fought, technically sharp opener.
On a Friday in 2023, back when FTR vs. Komander & Vikingo headlined Rampage, rated 8.08 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle in a physical tag team battle.

Rewind to 2021, when Lee Moriarty arrived in AEW, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.67 ? a good, competitive contest. Lee Moriarty was the clear standout of this tag match, using his size advantage to dominate two much smaller, faster opponents ? a real showcase performance that got the crowd firmly behind him, even in a losing effort.
